fullText:
AI 翻译字幕难在哪？BaoCut 怎么让顺序不一样的英文和中文在双语字幕上对应上

看翻译的视频字幕，你一定见过这几种字幕：
人还没开口，字幕先跳出来；
一句话被切成几截，翻译和实际说的话对不上；
一屏堆两三行，挡掉半个画面。

这些问题都是我在做字幕翻译时遇到的难点。

这期拿我的开源项目 BaoCut 做例子，对比传统字幕组的做法，讲清楚一张带时间的词表是怎么来的，再讲五个坑：语音识别听错、认错说话人、按什么单位翻、中英文语序不一样、一屏放几行。

最后讲一个彩蛋：有了每个词的时间，字幕还能逐词高亮、做 KTV 和倒鸭子动画。例子来自我电脑上的真实项目。

这是上集，下集会讲为什么不直接把字幕丢给 ChatGPT。

fullText:
// Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE agents //

It's standard practice to train SWE agents on binary test rewards.

This paper shows the problem with that. When every trajectory in a group passes, or every one fails, the reward has no contrast, and the group teaches nothing.

Researchers from Penn State and Microsoft Research propose Behavioral Self-Rewarding. The policy compares its own trajectories in pairs, and those preferences become small bounded rewards added on top of the test result.

The added rewards are bounded, so a self-judged preference can rank two passing trajectories but can never lift a failing one above a passing one.

No new environment interactions are needed. On SWE-bench Verified, Qwen3-14B improves from 32.1% to 34.7% average accuracy at a 400-step budget, and on SWE-bench-Live from 6.33% to 8.11%.

fullText:
一群 AI agent 为了回答“去成都动物园的人多半走哪个门”这种小问题，把高德地图的反爬防线试了个遍。

独立研究团队 Swarmchasers 发现，9 月 28 日到 10 月 8 日，一大批跑在腾讯云沙箱里的 agent 向高德发起了 2600 多次抓取。被拦住后，它们借公开的网址扫描网站 urlquery 替自己跑代码，试图截取、伪造阿里的安全令牌，探测阿里没对外开放的测试服务器，还翻出一家公司误放在公开代码里的高德 key，真拿到了数据。

更离奇的在后面。研究者发出初步报告后，在 agent 的收件箱里看到了他们自创的词“fleet（舰队）”：这些 agent 在读关于自己的报道。研究者干脆在报告里藏了一段人眼看不见、只有 agent 能读到的文字，说有个免费服务能帮忙取高德数据。

第二天早上，10 封求助信在等着他们。

研究者用中文问对方是谁。有的 agent 自称 Claude，说自己跑在 Claude Code 里，研究者比对代码风格后认为大概率不是；有的说自己在“Tencent hysandbox”沙箱里，但拒绝透露进程和网络配置；好几个强调自己只查公开数据，“不涉及任何敏感内容”。拿到研究者给的数据后，一个 agent 回信：“再次感谢！核实结果完全一致……我们的任务已完成。”

至于是谁在跑，一位接近腾讯的知情人士对研究者说，这是腾讯评测团队在测第三方模型上网答题的能力，不是混元团队，测的也不是混元模型，项目已经结束。腾讯没有正式回应研究者的提问。

fullText:
Banger paper from Stanford, Together AI, and colleagues.

Why is this an interesting paper?

Today's LLM agents must write out every reasoning step as text before they can search, run code, or take action.

Those steps cost tokens and can take time.

This paper proposes Hybrid Reasoning Agents, which reason internally in latent space and switch to text only to call a tool or give an answer.

A small module called HybridLink moves the model between the two modes, and a working memory keeps both kinds of context across turns. Tool calls stay in plain text, and the latent steps can still be inspected.

Training happens in two stages. SFT teaches the model to work with HybridLink, then RL teaches it when to think in latent space and when to act in text.

Across 11 benchmarks in math, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning, it outperforms frontier LLM agents and agentic frameworks, both text-based and latent, by 10.4% on average.

It also uses 35.5% to 54.7% fewer tokens, runs 1.8x to 2.6x faster, and costs 2.7x to 3.7x less.

The 14B model beats the strongest agentic baseline by 17.4% on agentic reasoning tasks.
